title: Smooth transitivity gives a short exact sequence of differential sheaves
statement:
Let $h:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and assume $h$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Use the relative Kähler differential sheaves with their universal derivations [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf] and tensor module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. The canonical differential map $d_{h/S}:h^*\Omega^1_{Y/S}\to\Omega^1_{X/S}$ of [def-a1-relative-differentials-pullback-map], sending $1\otimes du$ to $d(h^\sharp u)$, fits into a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules
$$0\longrightarrow h^*\Omega^1_{Y/S}\xrightarrow{d_{h/S}}\Omega^1_{X/S}\xrightarrow{q}\Omega^1_{X/Y}\longrightarrow0,$$
where $q$ sends $d_{X/S}v$ to $d_{X/Y}v$. Short exactness means exactness at every term [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]; in particular the first map is injective and the last map is surjective as maps of sheaves. No smoothness assumption on $g$, and no Noetherian, separation, or constant-relative-dimension hypothesis, is imposed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-differential-sheaf-transitivity-exact] to obtain the canonical last arrow q, its derivation formula, a zero-composite witness, exactness at the middle and Epi q. Retain also its affine comparison diagram for the first arrow.

On an affine triple U, V, W with h(U) contained in V and g(V) contained in W, the comparison identifies the restricted first arrow with tilde(uA), where uA(a tensor db) = a d(h-sharp b). The actual section maps compose by Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE. By smoothness [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], the section map B to C is smooth, hence formally smooth. Identify uA with KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange using the extension-restriction adjunction and extensionality on differential generators. The Jacobi-Zariski exact sequence and vanishing of H1Cotangent for a formally smooth algebra prove its injectivity, as in [lem-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-differentials-injective].

By [lem-sc-tilde-preserves-finite-limits], tilde preserves the monomorphism uA. The affine comparison diagram then makes the restriction of the canonical first arrow a monomorphism. The forgetful functor to abelian presheaves preserves limits, so each component of a module-sheaf monomorphism is injective [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

Prove cancellation of any two maps into the first term locally. For each point of each source open O, choose W around g(h(x)), V inside g-inverse(W), and U inside O intersect h-inverse(V), all affine. Restriction monicity gives equality on U, using naturality of the two maps. The sheaf separation axiom, including the empty cover when O is empty, gives equality on O. Thus the first arrow is monic. Combine it with middle exactness and Epi q to form ShortComplex.ShortExact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence].

lean.statement: theorem relativeDifferentials_transitivity_shortExact_of_smooth {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S) [Smooth h] : ∃ q : (h ≫ g).relativeDifferentials ⟶ h.relativeDifferentials, (∀ (O : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, O)), q.app O ((h ≫ g).relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := op O) a) = h.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := op O) a) ∧ ∃ z : g.relativeDifferentialsPullbackMap h ≫ q = 0, (ShortComplex.mk (g.relativeDifferentialsPullbackMap h) q z).ShortExact
